clues: This town is the chief town of the most peopled state in its land. It stands on the right bank of a great river.
Winters here are mild, with next to no snow. Summers stay mild to warm, soft for this part of the land.
This town won its town rights in 1288. The grant came in the wake of a great clash won by its count.
Near one fifth of the top trade fairs in the world are run by this town's fair firm. Its style fairs draw crowds from all lands.
This town is the heart of a vast metro zone. That zone is the second most rich in its whole union of lands.
